title: Build great software. Sell it on Zenith. · Zenith Hosting
excerpt: Build, test and submit your app with your coding agent and the Zenith CLI. Sell hosted instances while Zenith handles hosting, checkout and subscriptions.
content_html:
Turn your open-source app into a paid, hosted product. Zenith runs customer instances and handles subscriptions. You earn a share of the revenue.

Start buildingExplore the CLI

your-next-app — zsh

~❯npm install -g @zenith-hosting/cli

~❯zenith init

~❯pi "Build a book tracking app on Zenith."

Zenith sells managed hosting for your open-source software.

Bring your project. Give customers a hosted product they can buy and use immediately.

Build your app.

Keep writing code and shipping improvements. Turn the open-source project you care about into a product people pay for.

We run the service.

Every customer gets their own hosted instance. Zenith handles the hosting, checkout, and subscriptions for you.

Get paid for your work.

Earn 30% of eligible base subscription revenue. As customers subscribe to your app, you share in the revenue.

Your agent can do more than write the code.

  1. Check your setup.

    zenith check

    Checks your Zenith configuration before you deploy. Catch missing settings and fix them while you’re still working locally.

  2. Try your app online.

    zenith up

    Uploads and builds your app on Zenith, then gives you a temporary web address. Open it in your browser to test the app before you publish.

  3. Submit it for sale.

    zenith publish

    Sends your app and listing to Zenith for review. Once published, customers can subscribe and Zenith runs their hosted instances.

Packed with integrations.

SMTP, AI model routing, identity, storage, and runtime configuration. Configure the integrations your app needs in Zenith Compose.

Send app email through SMTP.

Zenith provides an authenticated SMTP relay for verification emails, password resets, and invitations. Your app receives the connection settings and sender address as environment variables.

Map Zenith’s SMTP variables to your mailer’s settings in Zenith Compose. The relay works in hosted previews and customer deployments.

Frequently asked questions

Publishing docs

Can I bring an existing app to Zenith?

Yes. Run zenith init in your project to add the Zenith files and agent skills without replacing your existing source files. To publish, you need a public GitHub repository, a Zenith Compose file, and permission to distribute the app. You can also claim an existing catalogue app through the developer dashboard after Zenith checks repository ownership.

Which integrations does Zenith provide out of the box?

Zenith provides an SMTP relay, routed AI models, generated secrets and environment variables, OpenID Connect sign-in, a file browser for declared storage, and forward authentication for protected endpoints. Configure the integrations your app needs in Zenith Compose. Zenith supplies the runtime credentials and settings to the services that use them.

What happens after I submit my app?

zenith publish sends your app and listing to Zenith for review. Follow progress and respond to feedback using zenith publish status or the developer dashboard. Submitting an app does not immediately put it on sale. When you submit an update to a published app, the current version stays live while the update is reviewed.

How much revenue do developers earn on Zenith?

Zenith’s standard developer revenue share is 30% of eligible base subscription revenue collected for your app. Taxes, refunds and separately charged platform add-ons are excluded. Separately agreed rates can differ. Your Developer Agreement defines the revenue that qualifies and the adjustments that apply.

When and how are developer earnings paid?

Statements are issued at least quarterly. An accumulated undisputed payable balance of US$50 or more at quarter-end is normally paid within 30 days, subject to the Developer Agreement’s verification, information, adjustment and hold terms. Recorded earnings, completed payouts and amounts owed are available in the developer dashboard.

Your app could be someone’s next favourite.

Give them a way to subscribe. Earn from the software you build.

Sell your app
